historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use to demolish an existing three-story building containing a vacant dwelling unit and a vacant ground-floor commercial space and build a three-unit, four-story residential building.
The property held an existing three-story building containing a vacant dwelling unit and a vacant commercial space at the ground floor.
